title: Guile in trade, a bank for water
literal_meaning: Trade by guile; water by an embankment.
meaning_odia: ଏଠାରେ ଛନ୍ଦର ଅଭିଧାନଗତ ଛଳ ବା କପଟ ଅର୍ଥକୁ ନେଇ ପଢ଼ାଯାଇଛି। ବନ୍ଧ ଯେପରି ପାଣିକୁ ଧରିରଖେ, ଛଳ ସେପରି ବଣିଜକୁ ଧରିରଖେ—ଏହା ଆମ ସମ୍ପାଦକୀୟ ବ୍ୟାଖ୍ୟା। କଥାଟି ବ୍ୟବସାୟ ବିଷୟରେ ଏକ ସନ୍ଦେହପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ ଧାରଣା ରଖୁଛି; ସବୁ ବ୍ୟବସାୟୀ କପଟୀ ବୋଲି ଏହା ପ୍ରମାଣ ନୁହେଁ।
explanation: The line pairs the means of holding water with what it presents as a means of sustaining trade. Taking ଛନ୍ଦ in its attested sense of guile gives the comparison a cynical edge: commerce is pictured as depending on manipulation. That contextual reading is editorial; the brief source supplies no separate gloss.
usage_example: Original imagined example: A seller’s presentation is found to hide important defects. A listener quotes the saying critically about that deal, without treating it as a rule about every business.
cultural_context: ଛନ୍ଦେ and ବନ୍ଧେ rhyme and occupy matching positions. The familiar embankment image gives a concrete shape to the more abstract claim about commercial dealings.

witnesses.locator: Page19, single line beginning ଛନ୍ଦେ ବଣିଜ.
witnesses.note: Rendered upload inspected17November2026. Exact wording retained. Guile selects the dictionary’s deceit/trick sense of ଛନ୍ଦ; sustaining trade/holding water is an explicitly editorial expansion of the verbless parallel.

graphic.caption: An imagined cloth transaction places a hidden flaw beside the retaining bank.

odia_summary: ଛଳ ଓ ବଣିଜକୁ ବନ୍ଧ ଓ ପାଣି ସହ ତୁଳନା କରୁଥିବା ପଢ଼ା।
english_summary: A cynical comparison pairs guile in commerce with an embankment holding water.
